meta.title: Lowgear Cycle Works | Bike repair in Hackney
meta.description: Bike servicing, same-day puncture and brake fixes, wheel building and steel frame restoration in a railway arch off Mare Street, Hackney.

rationale: A bike workshop in a railway arch should feel like its own shop sign, so the whole page sits on signal yellow with black type, heavy uppercase Big Shoulders and blunt copy. The poster hero says the one thing couriers and commuters need (back the same day), the big numbered index shows four services with rough prices, and the frame restoration story gives Dami's favourite work room to breathe. A black contact block at the end works like the arch door.

props.label: What we do

props.intro: Not sure which one you need? Turn up and we will look at the bike with you.

items.name: Servicing
items.description: Gears, brakes, bearings, chain and tyres checked and set up properly. Same day for most bikes.

items.name: Punctures and brakes
items.description: Flat tyre or spongy brakes? Stay and have a coffee, we fix them while you wait.

items.name: Wheel building
items.description: Hand-built wheels for commuting, couriering or hard use. Tell us how you ride and we choose the parts.

items.name: Frame restoration
items.description: Old steel frames stripped, repaired and brought back to life. Priced after we have seen the frame.

props.label: The arch
props.title: Old steel, ridden again.
paragraphs: Lowgear is Dami and Rosa, two mechanics in a railway arch in Hackney. Most of the bikes through the door belong to couriers and commuters who cannot be without a bike for long, so we work fast and we work straight.
The part Dami loves most is restoring old steel frames. A tired frame comes in, and after the strip-down, the repairs and a careful rebuild it goes out riding better than it has in years.
Whatever you bring us, you will know what it needs and roughly what it costs before we pick up a spanner.
props.pullQuote: Fast for the daily bike. Slow and careful for the old steel.
